name: Solstice Sleigh

passives.name: Going Sledding
passives.effects: Slowing or immobilizing an enemy champion causes you and the most wounded allied champion within 1500 units to gain 20% bonus movement speed decaying over 2.5 seconds and 50 – 230 (based on your level) hp bonus health for 2.5 seconds.

active.name: Ward
active.effects: Consumes a charge to place a Stealth Ward at the target location, which grants sight of the surrounding area. Charges refill upon visiting the shop.
